rentalSettings.depositFormulaV2: Deposit = multiplier × after-tax (rent + insurance + freight), rounded up. Held as a liability, not billed.

rentalSettings.subtitle: Configure insurance, deposits, shipping, pricing, and rental policies
rentalSettings.depositExplainer: Deposit = max(equipment MSRP x rate, category fallback). Industrial fallback: ${{industrial}}, Powersports: ${{powersports}}.
rentalSettings.depositFormula: Formula: deposit = max(equipmentMSRP x rate, fallback)
rentalSettings.shippingExplainer: Each vehicle is assigned to a shipping tier. Cost = Base Fee + max(0, distance - included km) x $/km. Equipment without a tier uses the default shipping fee.
rentalSettings.freightRulesDesc: Tunes how multi-item delivery and round-trip freight are priced.
rentalSettings.surchargePctHint: e.g. 50 means the 2nd item adds 50% of the largest single freight. Default 25%.
rentalSettings.roundTripHint: e.g. 2.0 = full double, 1.8 = 10% off round trip. Default 2.0.
